svg.title: From a table row to a disk sector
svg.desc: A conceptual illustration showing a physical hard disk, tracks and sectors, and a highlighted relational table row.
svg.text: A track is divided into sectors.
Highlighted sectors show an example storage location.
The same table's rows are distributed across multiple pages.
Conceptual relationship: table rows are stored across 8 KB SQL Server data pages. NTFS allocates database-file space in clusters; the device exposes sectors. A row does not map 1:1 to a sector.
